headline: 100 Children in Dhaka Receive Free Cleft Surgery
meta_description: An international medical mission in Dhaka, Bangladesh, is providing 100 children with free cleft surgeries, restoring their ability to eat, speak, and smile.
summary_short: An international medical mission in Dhaka is giving 100 children free cleft surgeries, transforming their lives and restoring confidence.
body:
An international medical mission operating in Dhaka, Bangladesh, is providing 100 children with free cleft surgeries. The procedures are restoring far more than physical appearance—they are giving these children back the ability to eat, speak, and smile with confidence.

Cleft conditions can profoundly affect a child's quality of life, making eating difficult and speech challenging. The psychological impact of visible facial differences often isolates children from their peers. By bringing surgical expertise to Dhaka, this mission removes barriers that many families cannot afford to overcome alone.

For the 100 children receiving care, the surgeries represent a turning point. Each operation opens doors to better nutrition, clearer communication, and renewed self-assurance. In a city where access to specialized surgical care is often limited, this international effort demonstrates how collaborative medical missions can transform childhood experiences and create lasting opportunities.
